title: 第17章 横渠四句是我们北冥书院被盗的第18章 嚣张的李夫子暴怒的沈浪
slug: 提蓝桥刚毕业女帝求我当宰相
content_zh:
;;
“你去告诉神霄，老夫正在读书，有什么事让她来见我！”
此话一出。
负责传递消息的书生，一脸的震惊：“夫子，那可是陛下呀！”
“陛下怎么了？”李夫子板起脸：“老夫有没有告诉过你们，身为读书人得有自己的风骨，一个陛下就能让你忘了风骨吗？”
遭到李夫子训斥，书生立刻挺直腰杆。
他觉得李夫子说的没毛病！
他们北冥书院的读书人眼中装着的都是天下。
神霄虽然贵为大乾女帝，也不能让他们折腰！
“学生知道该怎么做了！”
说完。
书生一脸严肃的走出了小院，冲着神霄道：“陛下，夫子正在读书，没时间来接驾！”
“您若是想见他，可自行前往！”
“放肆！”
听到书生这话，神霄还没说什么，上官冉俏脸一黑。
她简直不敢相信，北冥书院的夫子，竟然狂妄到了这种程度。
神霄亲临，不迎接也就罢了，竟然还敢让神霄去见他。
这大乾到底谁才是帝君？
同理，神霄此刻，脸色也是难看到了极点。
但想到自己今日过来，也算是有事相求，并不想把关系闹得太僵，导致最后沈浪无法入朝为官。

于是，神霄强压下心头的怒火，微笑道：“小冉，读书人最忌讳读书的时候被打断，朕正好闲来无事，就去见见夫子好了！”
“陛下，不可啊！”
眼见神霄竟然真的打算去见李夫子，上官冉也是有些着急的提醒。
但神霄却是缓缓摇头：“沈浪入朝为官对于朕来说，现在才是最重要的，其他的事情稍后再议吧！”
哎……
眼见神霄把话说到这种程度了。
上官冉的内心，哪怕极度不忿，也只能选择照做。
毕竟，大乾现在极度缺灵石，若是没有人帮衬神霄，可真的扛不了太久！
“夫子，陛下到了！”
很快，神霄与上官冉在书生的带领下，便来到李夫子的小院外。
引路的那名书生，也是立刻以狂热的姿态，冲着院内行礼。
院中的李夫子闻听此言，却是狂妄到了极点道：“到了就进来吧，还用我请吗？！”

"Go and tell Shenxiao that I am studying and ask her to come see me if you need anything!"
As soon as these words came out.
The scholar responsible for delivering the news looked shocked: "Master, that is Your Majesty!"
"What's wrong, Your Majesty?" Master Li asked with a serious face: "Have I ever told you that as a scholar, you must have your own character? Can Your Majesty make you forget your character?"
After being reprimanded by Master Li, the scholar immediately straightened his back.
He thinks what Master Li said is correct!
The scholars at Beiming Academy only have the world in their eyes.
Although Shenxiao is the empress of Daqian, she cannot let them bend!
“Students know what to do!”
Finished.
The scholar walked out of the small courtyard with a serious face and said to Shenxiao: "Your Majesty, the master is studying and has no time to pick him up!"
"If you want to see him, you can go there on your own!"
"Presumptuous!"
Hearing the scholar's words, Shangguan Ran's pretty face darkened before Shen Xiao said anything.
She simply couldn't believe that the master of Beiming Academy was so arrogant.
When Shen Xiao came in person, it was fine not to welcome him, but he actually dared to let Shen Xiao go see him.
Who is the emperor in this Dagan?
In the same way, Shen Xiao's face looked extremely ugly at this moment.
But thinking that he came here today, he had something to ask for, and he didn't want to make the relationship too tense, which would eventually prevent Shen Lang from joining the court as an official.
So, Shen Xiao suppressed the anger in his heart and said with a smile: "Xiao Ran, scholars are most afraid of being interrupted when they are studying. I just have nothing to do, so I will go see the master!"
"Your Majesty, no!"
Seeing that Shen Xiao actually planned to see Master Li, Shangguan Ran also reminded him a little anxiously.
But Shen Xiao slowly shook his head: "For me, Shen Lang's entry into the court as an official is the most important thing now. We can discuss other matters later!"
Hey...
Seeing Shen Xiao talking to this extent.
In Shangguan Ran's heart, even if he was extremely unhappy, he could only choose to do so.
After all, Daqian is currently very short of spiritual stones. If there is no one to help Shenxiao, he really won't be able to carry it for long!
"Master, His Majesty is here!"
Soon, Shen Xiao and Shangguan Ran, led by the scholar, arrived outside Master Li's small courtyard.
The scholar who led the way also immediately saluted into the courtyard with a fanatical attitude.
Master Li in the courtyard heard this, but he was extremely arrogant and said: "Come in when you get there, do you still need me to invite you?!"
